## P07.3 impersonation invariant model

Risk class: auth, transaction, data integrity. PostgreSQL is the supported grant and audit driver.

| Operation | Resource | Invariant and enforcement | Interference path | Evidence |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| Claim | Central `root_impersonation_grants` | One `UPDATE ... WHERE` checks unused, unrevoked, unexpired, nonempty reason, staff claimant, profile TTL, and regulated independent staff approver. An ambient central transaction is refused. | Two concurrent claimants serialize on the grant row; only one can update `used_at` from null. | `ImpersonationProfileTest` 27 cells; existing one-use flow test. |
| Start audit | Central `root_account_events` | Commit the event before any tenant mirror or login. Failure denies access; the claim stays used. | Central insert/commit can fail or have uncertain outcome. It is never rolled back by later tenant failure. | `ImpersonationAuditTest` central failure and tenant failure. |
| Tenant mirror | Tenant `sys_audit_log` | Standard and regulated use the stock `SynchronousAuditWriter`, which requires an event snapshot, rejects ambient transactions and commits before returning. Dev omits this mirror. Optional `AuditLogger` and queue settings have no effect. | Tenant insert/commit can fail after central intent commits; login stays closed. | Core writer persistence/transaction tests; tenancy stock writer and failure tests. |
| Session/login | Current request session and auth guard | Start records audit before setting impersonation keys and calling login. Login failure clears auth/session before failed audit. Stop clears auth/session before ended audit. | Audit failure cannot leave an opened impersonation session; a failed login leaves a consumed grant. | `ImpersonationTest`, `ImpersonationAuditTest`. |
| Write guard | Scoped guard instance | Only the current instance may temporarily permit an intentional model write; nested calls restore the previous value after exceptions. | Another scoped instance and later requests remain closed. | `ImpersonationWriteGuardTest`. |

No cross-database atomic commit is claimed. Central intent describes the attempted access and can remain without a tenant row after failure (PLAN3.D100). The later schema baseline migration belongs to P08.
